title: Webmin through 2.670 before ae8feb1 allows XSS via an SVG attachment in a mail queue, relevant if an authenticated…
description: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Webmin versions up to 2.670 before commit ae8feb1. This issue arises when an authenticated user uploads an SVG attachment to a mail queue, which an administrator then views, potentially leading to XSS execution.
